changes: Refresh saved prechecks before full profile validation
Require all 40 probe identities before accepting any pair
Require four released pins and both clean frozen worktrees before analysis submission
Replace stale replacement-pair caveat with this study protocol
Label GEMM traffic and roofline numbers as analytical model estimates
Include all observed nvjet_sm100 dense GEMM tiles/layouts, retaining exact 256x192/NNT cross-check
Cross-check dense GEMM counts and durations against every matching top profile kernel
Do not apply BF16 reference peaks or balance to FP32-input GEMMs
Capture bounded input dependency context and async callsites for uint32 all-reduces; no causal critical-path claim

checks.iris_wait: Read implementation: raise_on_failure defaults true and rejects every non-SUCCEEDED terminal state
checks.matmul_synthetic_xplane: passed: multiple tiles/layouts, BF16 and FP32 inputs and outputs, logical bytes, FLOPs, call counts and picosecond durations
checks.paired_intervals: passed: independently inverted paired-t statistic at Fieller endpoints
checks.uint32_dependency_context: Passed CPU-compiled direct all-reduce and parsed async-wrapper HLO: synthetic XPlane timings and real async callsite/input ancestry.

full_record.contents: Complete record including all derived profiles, dense GEMM workload descriptions and collection, validation and scoring sources.

summary.design: One of four predeclared confirmation pairs; score all relative steps 8 through 27.
limitations: One pair cannot estimate between-run uncertainty; no acceptance confidence interval is reported.
Loss checks cover only 28 updates and do not establish long-term convergence.
XPlane kernel durations cover two profiled steps and may overlap; they are not additive wall-time attribution.
Time outside other captured GPU work is not a causal estimate of critical-path savings.
HLO allocation totals describe planned memory by color, not physical GPU peak memory.

collection.semantics: Disjoint timestamp windows; rank 0 of task 0, attempt 0. Identical final-step duplicates are deduplicated by step. All 28 updates require finite loss and positive duration.

summary.design: One of four predeclared confirmation pairs; score all relative steps 8 through 27.
limitations: One pair cannot estimate between-run uncertainty; no acceptance confidence interval is reported.
Loss checks cover only 28 updates and do not establish long-term convergence.
XPlane kernel durations cover two profiled steps and may overlap; they are not additive wall-time attribution.
Time outside other captured GPU work is not a causal estimate of critical-path savings.
HLO allocation totals describe planned memory by color, not physical GPU peak memory.

promotion_status: Not promoted: the primary throughput interval is not strictly positive.

protocol.baseline_policy: Freeze current main plus native SM100 attention; do not promote inconclusive registration-only result into the baseline.
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Select latest complete hero checkpoint once at pair setup in-region; temporarily retain until both arms are terminal; require identical restored URI and step; restore original retention metadata.

protocol.hypothesis: Copy-engine all-gather may reduce competition for SMs; host-offload copies may instead contend for copy engines.

checks: finite loss at every matched step
identical first loss from the same restored checkpoint
report candidate-minus-control mean, maximum absolute, final, and last-seven differences per pair
loss_checks.limitation: Short-run numerical consistency only; no claim of unchanged long-term convergence.

protocol.purpose: Four fresh matched pairs to estimate the incremental throughput effect of registered all-gather with NCCL ZERO policy over current main plus native SM100 attention.
protocol.rack_policy: Require identical NVLink rack within the pair.

statistics.decision: Require positive lower throughput confidence bound, validated provenance, numerical gate, finite matched loss trajectories, and no unexplained correctness issue. Otherwise retain the existing baseline.
statistics.primary: 100 * (mean of four control run means / mean of four candidate run means - 1)
statistics.replicate: one matched run pair, never individual steps
statistics.seconds_saved: paired Student-t interval across four pair differences
statistics.sensitivity: Exclude absolute steps divisible by ten; primary includes all scored steps.
statistics.stopping: Run all four valid pairs. No extra pairs or early acceptance based on intermediate timing results. Stop for correctness failure, operational failure requiring investigation, or user instruction. Record exclusions and any deviation.
statistics.uncertainty: two-sided 95% paired Fieller interval with Student-t critical value and 3 degrees of freedom

same_source_replay_loss.difference: Later same-source run minus earlier same-source run, matched by checkpoint and relative step.
same_source_replay_loss.scope: Descriptive replay variation only. Two runs per source/checkpoint do not define a numerical equivalence margin or establish long-term convergence.

summary.caveat: Four predeclared matched run pairs in T/C, C/T, T/C, C/T order; all four pairs included, with no replacements or timing-based exclusions. Primary scoring uses every relative step 8–27. Pair-level t and paired Fieller intervals assume independent approximately normal run-pair means. The exploratory selection pair is excluded.
summary.scope: Short restored one-rack training comparisons; loss checks do not establish unchanged long-term convergence.
